api.base_url: https://api.laserfiche.com/repository/v2 (US cloud) - UNVERIFIED this turn; regional hosts exist

scopes_needed_read: table.Read (OData table API) - scope names UNVERIFIED
auth.refresh: Developer site lists Service Principals plus OAuth 2.0 flows (service apps, single-page apps, web apps). Service app: Developer Console service application bound to a Service Principal user, authenticated with a base-64 encoded access key created on the app's Authentication tab (secondary: Boomi/ABBYY docs).

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Cloud admin creates a Service Principal user (Laserfiche doc: authenticates with a rotatable API key, no MFA), registers a service app in the Developer Console with that principal as service account, creates an access key, and grants the principal read rights on the target repository folders.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: $0 (API included with Laserfiche Cloud; self-hosted needs the Laserfiche API Server - UNVERIFIED)
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Immediate once admin creates principal and key

sandbox.how_to_get: Swagger playground on developer.laserfiche.com against a Laserfiche Cloud account; free developer account details UNVERIFIED.

incremental_sync: UNVERIFIED. Repository search/entry listing supports metadata and modification-time queries; confirm in the Repository API reference.
blockers: Self-hosted customers need Laserfiche API Server and network reachability (UNVERIFIED)
Developer docs are JS-rendered; scopes, limits and token lifetimes need confirming on a loaded page
